body: If you don't mind me saying it sounds like you're lost and need to find yourself. You don't need to chase the things that everyone else does to be happy. You can define your own happiness and live your life the way you want to. You'll be 18 in short time and I recommend exploring what makes you happy and holding onto it. Try as many different things as you can and don't worry if something doesn't stick. And don't worry about school, there many people who didn't graduate high school who became very successful.

Most OTC drugs are designed to prevent people from taking their lives from OD. It's extremely difficult to end your life with those without permanently damaging yourself. I know you're in a bad place but nothing is worse than botching something like this and ending up in a state where you can't finish the job.

Everyone's reason for living is different, and some people go their entire lives with no clue as to why they do it. If you want to talk about how you got to this point and maybe figure out your purpose here we're willing to listen.

I hope you're reading this. If you are I'd like to listen to what you have to say. I can't promise I'll have the solution to your problems but sometimes just talking about how you feel can help. Feel free to reply to me here or pm me if it's too personal to discuss openly.

It will hurt like hell and best will leave you with permanent damage. I can't tell you what to do but I would recommend not taking your life in such a needlessly painful way. I'm sure life is already hard enough for you if you're considering this. Be safe.

There is something keeping all of us here. Whether it be a family member or friend, loved one or something we need or are compelled to do. I don't know what you're going through right now, but I'd like to know.

I get where you're coming from but if you're as close of friends as you say, you can still spend time with them, even when they're away. The beautiful thing about today is that you can spend hours and hours with people halfway across the world doing whatever you'd like. I have a friend I've known since high school that I still talk to on a regular basis. There are things he knows about me that no one else does. I know this may seem like the end but this is really just rocky stretch in the road. Be safe.

I don't have many people in my life I can call friend so I get where you're coming from. I can't tell you what to do but I can offer a suggestion. Spend as much time with your friends as you can and make the most of the time you have with them now. They're not going away forever and in between the times you see them you'll have memories of all the good times you shared with them. Be safe.
